<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Seite-1" id="25DQQ9Z7hsWc8zE8eeoy"> <mxGraphModel dx="1030" dy="626" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph LR

 subgraph \"mex/model\"
 direction TB

 subgraph entities[\"entities/\"]
 direction TB
 E_extracted[\"extracted-*.json&lt;br/&gt;&lt;i&gt;(14 entity types)&lt;/i&gt;\"]
 E_merged[\"merged-*.json&lt;br/&gt;&lt;i&gt;(14 entity types)&lt;/i&gt;\"]
 E_concept[\"concept.json\"]
 E_conceptScheme[\"concept-scheme.json\"]
 end

 subgraph fields[\"fields/\"]
 F_identifier[\"identifier.json\"]
 F_link[\"link.json\"]
 F_text[\"text.json\"]
 end

 subgraph vocabularies[\"vocabularies/\"]
 V_schemes[\"concept-schemes.json&lt;br/&gt;&lt;i&gt;(enumerates schemes)&lt;/i&gt;\"]
 V_rest[\"activity-type.json&lt;br/&gt;theme.json&lt;br/&gt;language.json&lt;br/&gt;… (20 more files)\"]
 end

 subgraph i18n[\"i18n/\"]
 I_de[\"de.po\"]
 I_en[\"en.po\"]
 end

 subgraph extension[\"extension/\"]
 EX[\"definition.json\"]
 end
 end

 %% Entities → Fields via $ref
 E_extracted -- \"$ref: /mex/model/fields/{text,link,identifier}\" --> fields

 %% Entities reference other merged entities via $ref
 E_extracted -- \"$ref: merged-*#/identifier<br/><i>(inter-entity links)</i>\" --> E_merged

 %% Vocabulary-typed fields point to concept#/identifier + useScheme
 E_extracted -- \"$ref: concept#/identifier<br/>+ useScheme: …/{scheme}\" --> E_concept

 %% Concept → ConceptScheme via required inScheme
 E_concept -- \"$ref: concept-scheme#/identifier<br/><i>(required inScheme)</i>\" --> E_conceptScheme

 %% ConceptScheme uses field types too
 E_conceptScheme -- \"$ref: fields/text<br/><i>(label, description)</i>\" --> fields

 %% vocabularies/concept-schemes.json enumerates known schemes
 V_schemes -. \"enumerates known<br/>scheme identifiers\" .-> E_conceptScheme

 %% Other vocabulary files contain concept instances
 V_rest -. \"concept instances<br/>belonging to schemes\" .-> E_concept

 %% i18n labels entities & fields
 i18n -. \"labels for entity<br/>& field names\" .-> entities
 i18n -. \"labels for<br/>field names\" .-> fields

 %% extension adds display metadata to entities
 extension -. \"display order,<br/>grouping metadata\" .-> entities",
 "config": null
